name: progress-ring
title: Progress Ring
summary: A small ring that shows a task's progress, with a count or a mark in its centre.
description: A small ring that shows a task's progress, with a count or a mark in its centre. Small progress ring with content in the center: the task badge. A custom property drives the arc; the root is a progressbar.

anatomy.description: rotated -90deg so the arc starts at 12 o'clock

progress.description: 0..1. Out-of-range and non-finite values are clamped.

label.description: Accessible name of the progress bar.

notes: aria-valuenow is the progress as a whole percentage; give the ring a label that says what is progressing.
The center content is visual shorthand (a step number); the label and value carry the meaning.

motion: arc: stroke-dashoffset over duration.move, easing.out-strong when progress changes; jumps under prefers-reduced-motion
tone: the stroke colour changes over duration.base ease, with the travel (a completion turns green as the arc lands)
